controls: Never select a new non-owner-handpicked Commons painting merely because Commons says public domain
Retain object-level duplicate photo selections separately from physical painting count
No automated image upgrades or generic colour auto-correction
No substitution of panorama/detail/reverse canvas for the full selected painting
Photographic rights, same-painting geometry and crop/colour fidelity are independent gates
No artist attribution flattened from historical to current without provenance
GitHub Actions and Pages only for actual future app publishing; this phase changes no published assets
